def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    c=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    def u(a): return len(set(a))==1 and a[0]!=bg
    sepR=[i for i in range(H) if u(g[i])]
    sepC=[j for j in range(W) if u([g[i][j] for i in range(H)])]
    out=[[x for x in row] for row in g]
    if sepC:
        pC=sepC[0]
        bl=[g[i][:pC] for i in range(H)]
        for i in range(H):
            for j in range(pC,W):
                out[i][j]=bl[i][j%pC]
    return out

print('demo:', solve(G['Demo pair 1 input'])==G['Demo pair 1 output'])

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    c=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    def u(a): return len(set(a))==1 and a[0]!=bg
    sepR=[i for i in range(H) if u(g[i])]
    sepC=[j for j in range(W) if u([g[i][j] for i in range(H)])]
    out=[[x for x in row] for row in g]
    if sepC:
        pC=sepC[0]+1
        for i in range(H):
            for j in range(pC,W):
                out[i][j]=g[i][j%len(out[i][:pC])]
    return out
print('demo:', solve(G['Demo pair 1 input'])==G['Demo pair 1 output'])
import json
t=G['Test input']; o=solve(t)
for r in o: print(r)

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    c=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    def u(a): return len(set(a))==1 and a[0]!=bg
    sepR=[i for i in range(H) if u(g[i])]
    sepC=[j for j in range(W) if u([g[i][j] for i in range(H)])]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    if sepR and sepR[-1]<H-1:
        bh=len(g)-sepR[-1]-1
        blk=[r[:] for r in g[sepR[-1]+1:H]]
        b0=0
        for s in sepR+[H-1]:
            if s==H-1: continue
            for k in range(min(s-b0,bh)):
                for j in range(W):
                    out[b0+k][j]=blk[k][j]
            b0=s+1
    return out
print('demo:', solve(G['Demo pair 1 input'])==G['Demo pair 1 output'])
t=G['Test input']; o=solve(t)
for r in o: print(r)
print(json.dumps(o))

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    c=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    def u(a): return len(set(a))==1 and a[0]!=bg
    sepR=[i for i in range(H) if u(g[i])]
    sepC=[j for j in range(W) if u([g[i][j] for i in range(H)])]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    if sepR or (not sepC):
        # vertical: periodic band delimited by sep rows
        prev=0
        srcSt=None
        best=(-1,None)
        for s in sepR+[H]:
            st,en=prev,s-1
            nb=sum(any(x!=bg for x in r) for r in g[st:en+1])
            if srcSt is None or nb>best[0]:
                best=(nb,st)
            prev=s+1
        srcStart,bh=best
        src=[r[:] for r in g[srcStart:srcStart+bh]]
        for s in sepR+[H]:
            st,en=prev,s-1
            for k in range(en-st+1):
                out[st+k]=src[k%bh]
            prev=s+1
    elif sepC:
        # horizontal: block left of first sep col repeats
        src=[g[i][:sepC[0]] for i in range(H)]
        p=sepC[0]
        for i in range(H):
            for j in range(p,W):
                out[i][j]=src[i][j%p]
    return out
